resources.string: Step 1 is not done: the game code is not on this device. It is made from your own disc.\nOn your PC, run setup\\setup.cmd -Game mw2 (on Linux: bash setup/setup.sh --game mw2) with this device connected over USB.\nNo PC? Settings, Files, Prepare files for building online.

The game code on this device does not match this version of the app: %1$s.\n\nBuild it again: on your PC, update the project folder (git pull) and run setup\\setup.cmd -Game mw2 -GameOnly with this device connected over USB. If you built it online: in your private repository, Actions, Build my game package, Run workflow. Your game files and saves are kept.
